TextJPN: 「えーっと、@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3012.…『このトランプは不幸のトランプです。@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3013.これを使ったゲームで後輩の女の子をけちょんけちょんにしてしまうと、以後８世紀にわたり子々孫々まで祟られることになるでしょう。@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3014.その祟りを回避するためには、たとえどんな大勝利でもその権利を放棄して後輩の、それも髪が短いほうの女の子を勝利者として崇めたてることが最善です。@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3015.さすれば未来永劫、あなたとその家族と子孫は幸せな運命を全うすることができるでしょう』@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3016.――だ、そうだ」
TextENG: ``Okay, so.@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3012. ``These playing cards are cards of misfortune.@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3013. If you use them to thoroughly defeat girls younger than you in a card game, you and your descendants will be cursed for the next eight centuries.@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3014. In order to avoid this curse, you must waive your right to victory, no matter how overwhelming your advantage may be, and instead recognize a girl with short hair who is younger than you as the winner.@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3015. By doing so, you and your descendants will be blessed with good fortune for eternity.``@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3016. ―That's what it says.``

TextJPN: 「あらぁぁ～？@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3002.　それはお気の毒ですわねぇ、圭一さん？」
TextENG: ``Oooh~?@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3002. You must be devastated to learn about this, right, Keiichi-san?``

TextJPN: 「せっかく滅多にない大勝利なのに、その権利をみすみす放棄しなくてはいけないなんて！@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3004.　…まぁ私も、圭一さんが祟りにお遭いになられては可哀想ですから、不本意ではございますがその権利を甘んじてお受け、」
TextENG: ``To have such a rare opportunity for victory snatched away right before your eyes!@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3004. ...Well, Keiichi-san, I feel sorry for you as well, since I would not want you to be cursed either. It is with great reluctance that I resign myself to accepting this victory.``

TextJPN: 「――んきゃあぁぁっ？！@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3006.　な、なにをするのでございますかぁぁ？！」
TextENG: ``―Eek?!@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3006. What is it you are trying to do here?!``

TextJPN: 「……あのな、沙都子。@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3018.箱の裏側に仕掛けられたこんなメモを読んで、俺が本気で信じると考えられたことのほうが俺にはショックだ！@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3019.　沙都子のトラップの泉も、ついにその源が干上がったってことかぁぁっ？！」
TextENG: ``...Hey, Satoko.@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3018. It would be far more shocking to me if I found out you actually think I'd believe this note taped onto the box!@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3019. So your fountain of traps has finally dried up at its sooouurcee?!``

TextJPN: 「わ、私が仕掛けたわけではございませんわぁぁっ？！@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3008.　だいたいこんなしょぼい罠を、私が仕掛けるはずがないでしょうに！！」
TextENG: ``I- it's not like I was the one who taped that note to the box?!@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3008. I would never come up with such a shabby trap in the first place!!``

TextJPN: …大富豪が終わった、直後のことだ。
TextENG: ...It was right after we finished playing Millionaire.

TextJPN: 死闘を終えて、トランプをしまいかけた魅音が『あれ？』と紙の箱の裏側に書かれたものを見つけたのが、事の発端だった。
TextENG: It all started after we overcame our mortal struggle and were about to finish the card game, when Mion noticed that something was written on the back of the box and went ``What's this?``.

TextJPN: 先ほどの文章は手書きで、実に器用なかたちで記されてあった。…それゆえ真っ先に誰が疑われるのか、改めて皆に問うまでもないだろう。
TextENG: The handwriting of that text honestly seemed really skillful. ...So there shouldn't be any reason to ask everyone who the most likely suspect is here.

TextJPN: 「だいたいお前以外に、ここまであからさまにお前のメリットを確保する文面を書くやつがどこにいる！@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3021.　さぁ、吐け沙都子！@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3022.　今ならデコピン１グロスで済ませてやる！！」
TextENG: ``Who other than you would write something so blatantly designed to give you an advantage in the first place!@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3021. Come on, Satoko, admit it!@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3022. If you confess now, we can resolve this with only 1 gross forehead flicks!``

TextJPN: 「…１グロスって、いくつ？」
TextENG: ``...How many is 1 gross?``

TextJPN: 「１２ダースで１グロスなので、しめて１４４発なのですよ」
TextENG: ``1 gross is 12 dozen, so 144 times in total.``

TextJPN: 「はぅ、梨花ちゃん物知りだね～」
TextENG: ``Hau, Rika-chan, you know so much~!``

TextJPN: 「じょ、冗談じゃありませんわぁぁっ！！@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3010.　１００発以上おデコをぶたれるのもご勘弁ですが、冤罪で裁かれるのはもっともっとご免でございましてよ――っっ！！」
TextENG: ``Th- this is no joke!!@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3010. I would rather prefer to avoid my forehead being hit over 100 times, and I strongly resent these false accusations!!``

TextJPN: 沙都子は本気で心外とばかりに、真っ赤な顔で否定する。…その反応に、いつもの言い逃れだと思っていた俺も、さすがに思いとどまって再度、沙都子に聞き直した。
TextENG: Satoko is denying this with a bright red face. She appears to be genuinely offended. ...I thought it was just her usual evasive talk, but her reaction is making me reconsider that, so I ask her once more.

TextJPN: 「…本当に、沙都子じゃないのか？」
TextENG: ``...It really wasn't you, Satoko?``

TextJPN: 「だから、そう申し上げましたでしょうがっ！@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3012.　本当に、私ではございませんっっ！！」
TextENG: ``It is as I said!@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3012. It genuinely wasn't me who did it!!``

TextJPN: 「本当の本当に、違うんだな？@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3025.　神様と仏様と俺に誓えるか？」
TextENG: ``It really, truly, was someone else?@k@vS20/01/VTT_keiichi3025. Would you swear that on God, on Buddha, and on me?``

TextJPN: 「…最後だけどうにも胡散臭くて不本意ですが、@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3014.…とりあえず、誓いますわ。@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3015.これは、私が仕掛けたものではありませんでしてよ」
TextENG: ``...That last one seems awfully dubious, so I am a bit reluctant,@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3014. but yes, I swear.@k@vS20/04/VTT_satoko3015. This was not something set up by me.``

TextJPN: 「そうだね。@k@vS20/02/VTT_rena3018.沙都子ちゃんにしてはちょっと杜撰すぎるトラップだと、レナも思うな」
TextENG: ``That's right.@k@vS20/02/VTT_rena3018. I also think this trap was a bit too sloppy to have been done by Satoko.``

TextJPN: 「そう言われてみれば、そうだね。@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3020.…でも、だとしたらいったい誰が？」
TextENG: ``Now that you say that, I feel the same.@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3020. But if not Satoko, who was it?``

TextJPN: 「…みぃ。@k@vS20/05/VTT_rika3003.このトランプは、魅ぃが封を開けるまで新品だったはずなのですよ」
TextENG: ``...Meep.@k@vS20/05/VTT_rika3003. Before Mii opened these cards, they should have been brand new.``

TextJPN: 「うん…。@k@vS20/02/VTT_rena3020.魅ぃちゃんが目の前でビニールの包装を取るの、レナもちゃんとしっかり見てたし」
TextENG: ``Yeah...@k@vS20/02/VTT_rena3020. I also saw how you peeled off the vinyl wrapper, Mii-chan.``

TextJPN: ……だとしたら、いったい誰が？
TextENG: ...Then, who could it possibly have been?

TextJPN: 全員頭を抱えて考えてはみたが、…この謎は結局、不可思議なまま解明することができなかった。
TextENG: Everyone tried to wrap their heads around it, ...but in the end, we had to leave this inexplicable mystery unsolved.

TextJPN: ほぼ間違いなく、部活メンバーの誰かの仕業に違いないんだが…うぅ～～む。
TextENG: It would almost definitely have to have been one of the club members, but... hmm.
